About half of all adults say they feel lonely.
And loneliness can harm your health as much as smoking fifteen cigarettes a day.
If you're surrounded by people and still feel alone, this is for you.
Loneliness isn't about how many people you know.
It's about feeling seen by even one of them.
Loneliness makes you read rejection where there is none.
So you pull back. And pulling back makes you lonelier.
You can break that cycle today.
Send one message. Not a perfect one. A real one.
Say yes to one invitation you'd normally skip.
Ask one person how they're really doing. Then listen.
Everyone you admire has felt exactly this.
You're not too much. You're not too little.
You're just not yet in the right room.
